scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
I came here because I wanted to express my gratitude.
Thanks to you, things have gotten better...

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
However, not everything is going as expected.
I think I may have to take Peter's place instead.
What does that mean?

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
It appears I'm next in line to the throne.
This is not what I wanted.

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
Everyone else has a better right to the throne, they're natural and qualified for it.
This is quite strange and unfamiliar to me.

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text: I've been in some discussions with the Schwarz's government, so I'll be busy for a while...

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
It seems to me they like this arrangement.
I believe the relationship between our two countries will be maintained in the future thanks to our efforts.

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
If you still plan on attacking other enterprise facilities, you may want to rest first.
For the time being, you will need strength.

scripts.speaker: Nihil
scripts.text:
I hope you'll keep on going.
Thank you again for all the help.
I have to go now.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Hold on!
We have recently expanded the field of operations.
Due to this expansion, we've been able to set up a new base in Einbroch.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Let me revel to you the new bases location.
not far from the Einbroch railway station... there's a small bar called <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, the next operation will be carried out there.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: I've delivered the information!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
It's a small bar next to the train station of Einbroch.
<NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. Don't you think it's a cute name for a pub?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Oh! Welcome back!
How are you doing lately?
We found an entry.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
I see... There was an entrance...
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm heading back to Cat on Bullet and I'll be resting a bit.
About Dien.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: Dien is having a cup of tea on the second floor, in her room.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: Dien is having a cup of tea on the second floor, in her room.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: What? I'm busy right now!
- It contains an envelope. -
Take a look.
Just take it.
Leave it.
- It's an old picture with people you've met before. -
- I took the picture with me, let's give it back to Dien. -
- Carefully closed the box again. -
- I took the picture with me, let's give it back to Dien. -
- It's locked. -

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Hooray, finally some air, huh.
Let's go to Yuno. Huh?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Here, come. Here it is, Come over here.
Where are we going?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: That's what I'm trying to define adventurer. How can I set a destination when we have a VIP with us?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Where do we go? The VIP will decide. I will follow wherever you choose.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Don't you have to go the headquarters to investigate?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
I don't have to go to the headquarters to investigates~
Let's first look at the situation and the background information we have.
Then we'll look at the circumstances surrounding it.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you know how to investigate, set yourself a concrete goal with a detailed plan? I know a thing or two~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Ahahaha! Courtesy, courtesy! Let's be polite to our VIP!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: How about we start with something a little less difficult, how about we start this investigation differently? How about we let the VIP choose.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Well, what am I supposed to choose?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Pick on of the names on the list randomly. If I select one, you'd say I manipulated the results later otherwise.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Why are you looking at me like that? Don't you believe my heart?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Here, I choose that one. What are we going to do next?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Let me see... ^0000CDPatrick Kaufmann^000000.
Well... that name is long, let's call him ^0000CDPat^000000 instead.
Don't change his name!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Oh? Is it not economical? What's wrong, we'll save time using the name.
Also this will be a codename we can use among ourselves when refer to this scientist.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I've been an agent for a long time, I know these things. There's an official way to handle these, but I can't tell you that information.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Now, can we all go together and find Pat? Lighthalzen is to the east. It is often said to be a ^0000CDslum^000000. Of course, our VIP knows all about this already, right?
You'd have read this in your paperwork.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What's your plan?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Since he was a child, he would pick things up and fix them, and then resell. It's a talent that's been lost nowadays.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: At the age 21, he received a special award for low-income families. It caused a lot of envy from the people around him.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
He was moved to another Rekenber facility after 5 months, and then there is no record after that.
That's all the information about Pat.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Our VIP has chosen a very suitable candidate for our investigation. I applaud you. It was a good idea.
It's not a common person on the list.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Are we only going to investigate him? What about the others?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
How do you want to investigate so many people with only so few of us?
We focus on one person, don't you know how it works?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: After all, they all disappeared in a similar fashion. So once we figure out what happened to one of them, we'll know what happened to the rest too.
What am I going to do here?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Good morning~ From now on VIP's, the journey of Pat from his work to Rekenber to the present is for us to figure out~ with Lazy and his team~

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: So what? When you do your investigations, do you think it's a game?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Do I seem like a joke to you VIP?
I'm quite serious, don't you believe me VIP?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We'll follow Pat's work schedule. We can follow his traces and understand a bit more about what happened as to why he's missing.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: You've never taken a good look at the Lighthalzen village. I'm from a big city and I know a few places I can recommend to start with.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: When you say Lighthalzen is a village, what do you mean?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Guard, are you tired? Compared to Yuno, Lighthalzen is a small village.
Yuno is a really nice place. I often say this. Yuno is the city of Sages. Well, I would say it differently.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
The jewel of Rune-Midgard, the heart of the country, is Yuno. Everyone should visit at least once.
If anyone would ask me about the future of Rune-Midgard, I'd bet my life it would be the brilliant city of Yuno.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Anyway, there's nothing as good as traveling around here and there.
It's also very good to deceive others. Why would suspect a tourist? Right?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Should we really do that? Go to the headquarters and investigate?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: There are some things you can't learn from paperwork. Can a VIP explain what the yellow color is someone who doesn't know yellow?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Wouldn't it be quicker to just show the person yellow flowers and explain it?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There are many things I don't know outside my papers. That's partly why I came along with you.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: That's right. Do you feel bad? It's the truth though. Only mouth to mouth reveal true facts.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I understand. If we don't go over there, there will be only controversy with our reports.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
That's the purpose of this tour. Now let's go, we don't have much time.
Let's head over there with a non-fair First Class seat, it will be more comfortable.
First Class? Last time we traveled...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Hey!! I'm on official duty now! I'm also going to take First Class.
Does the adventurer not have a First Class fake pass?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Nobody has the money to pay First Class except the VIP. He can just bring us along.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Hmm!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Thank you! Courtesy, courtesy! Now, let's all go to <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now, let's all go to <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Aren't you supposed to be working right now?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Shouldn't we listen to what Daisy have to say?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Do you know where Daisy is trying to bring us? Can we trust you?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Here we are, Sector 01 - Section 95-146 in the Einbroch Mountains.
This is the new laboratory.
There's nothing here.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I thought it was here. Lazy must be wondering ^0000FFwhat this means.^000000 I only saw the world from sitting at my desk. I believed my view was true.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Everything I've heard and saw... I feel as if there was an invisible person manipulating everything. This is not a scenario I thought could be possible.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Even if everything looks fine on the surface, there are so many lies within. I've been deceived.
If you don't investigate with suspicious, you won't see any problems on the surface.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: But that's so... not trusting...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes... that's true.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hey, you're there already. How is it? What have you found out with your own two eyes?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I realized that papers are easy tools to deceive someone who's only sitting at a desk and doing their own thing.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
There is no lab here. There was nothing on our end either.
Absolutely nothing.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If everything on that document is false, then we can't find any more information.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: What do we do now?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Well. We have to keep looking for the location of this new laboratory. When we find it, we'll have to research it from the inside.
You don't have anything else Lazy?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Dear adventurer, have you forgotten who's been helping you now? The Rebellion has been roaming these areas.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The laboratory that I discovered a while, and the waste site. I'm sure it's only a matter of time before it's revealed. It must be nearby.
How do you know?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
It requires a large workforce and a lot of materials to build a research facility. Even after its construction, materials should still be constantly coming in.
Wouldn't it be too hard for such supplies to pass through the borders?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
So the laboratory is probably still in Schwarzwald. The materials can't be transported in the open,
so we have to look for a secret location, I guess it's going to be in one of those locations.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Did you hear that? That's smart.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: As of now, Rekenber will now ^0000FFdedicate itself to cooperate with the investigation.^000000 Please tell me everything you need. We'll support you anyway we can.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Alright, I'm glad to hear it, and I will gladly accept your cooperation.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I would like to personally apologize to Daisy. I'm sorry I didn't believe you. Thank you for coming to us.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Daisy, if you need anything, please come and visit me at anytime.
You'll always be welcome.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: In the future, please call me Lazy. Let's go with me for another adventurer one day. Come to Yuno every now and then.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: But that's for another day. Let's focus on the mission at hand.
Should I investigate further?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Why not? What more can you do here, Hmm. I'm a little hungry. My legs hurt too. I need to get back to work. I'll have to deal with the VIP as well.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
As such, I'm going to report the investigation regarding Pat's journey.
Everyone, let's go back to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>~

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Did you go to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> yet?
Let's hurry. There's still a lot to do.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Let's go back to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.
I think we should hurry.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Let's go to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.
I'm already hungry.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Hehe?...
I can't believe this area is disguised as an abandoned mine.
Such a clumsy tricks~ He~ Boring~
Please talk.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Shh!
Not so loud!!
If we get caught, we're done for!!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: Oh... I thought you were a rebellion member too.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Do you see the ^FF0000mine entrance^000000 blocked by wire mesh?
I think it's the entrance to their main base.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: I tried to get in a while ago, but it was blocked by wire mesh. I could see suspicious movements from the outside.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: If you go in by force, you will get chased down by dogs. You should ^FF0000scout nearby^000000 and wait for more support.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
I've never seen anyone go onside...
I don't really know what's going to happen, so why don't you go have a look around?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
I've never seen anyone go onside...
I don't really know what's going to happen, so why don't you go have a look around?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Hmmm.
There are no signs of people around...
I'm going inside.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
I'm not joking, it's dangerous.
You're just going in to look right?
Tell me again when you're ^FF0000ready to go inside.^000000

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: Are you all set?
Open the gate.
Go inside.
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
It's dangerous to go alone.
Wouldn't it be nice to go in with a ^FF0000party^000000?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
That's weird~
Wait a minute.
Maybe the ^FF0000party leader^000000 hasn't opened the gate yet?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: Please wait a minute.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
That's weird~
Wait a minute.
I don't think the gate is open, right?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
What?!
Have you forgotten the road to Clana Nemieri?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: What happened to you?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
What?!
Dien's room?
It's on the second floor of Clana Nemieri.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Huh...
It used to be great...
It was great...

- Nothing special here. -
- Let's go back to the Rebellion. -

- Nothing special here. -
- Let's look somewhere else. -

scripts.speaker: Republic Guard
scripts.text:
I've been contacted by Tes.
Don't worry I belong to the Secret Wing.
Aas and Est went to look around this area.

scripts.speaker: Republic Guard
scripts.text: Oh, there they are.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
You've arrived at a good time.
I was just about to enter.
I've already used all the guys I brought along, so I needed some back up.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: It looks like there aren't enough to go inside...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: That was the plan. I told our soldiers to not harm anyone, and to keep a lookout. They won't fight carelessly.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
I need to know more about the current situation.
So first things first, this operation is meant to gather more information, and then we'll launch a full attack later...

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Hehe. Right. So me and Aas will go first.
The rest will be waiting, and they'll come in and when we give the signal.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
It's more important to block out all the exits so that nobody escapes.
Everyone else, you know what to do right?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
I'll go using another route, I'll leave it up to Aas and the adventurer.
Let's meet inside.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Yes I understand.
Well then, I'll tell Oscar to open the door. We have to do this!

scripts.speaker: Republic Guard
scripts.text:
The entrance is secured by Oscar who is standing up ahead the front gate.
Me and the Rebellions will stay outside. Aas will be inside.
Good luck!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
We have to open the main gate.
Let's open the door with Oscar.

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
The entrance for the lab has double locks.
It's closed from the inside.
It will be difficult to get it.

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
I'm not too sure about the locks on the inside, so I don't know yet.
Let's secure 'Regenschirm' and find out.
Are you ready?

scripts.text: The route hasn't been secured yet. Why don't you ask your party leader to prepare the route?

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
If you're ready, please enter.
The locks on the inside will be handled by Aas.

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
They already secured the route.
Let's quietly move inside.

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
There was a movement detected on the route that we've secured.
Let's wait a bit.

scripts.speaker: Oscar
scripts.text:
You have a message from Tes back at the Cat on Bullet.
Please return back soon.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Please gather around~ Let's check the number of people! Kaya Tos! Kaya Tos?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Oh, there you are! Gather around!
There we're all together now!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: The investigation is looking good, but could you stop this ridiculous behavior.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I thought the VIP said there were only two conditions? Besides, everyone has already heard me.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We're now officially travelers from the Schwarzwald Republic. It would be hard to look around while hiding everywhere we went to anyway.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Traveling here is truly awesome~ I can feel this excitement. How do you think historians will write this day?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Kaya, relax. Leave your problems behind and just pretend you're on a holiday. You'll get a clearer perspective.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
First, try to look around on this trip. See how you feel about it.
What should you do if you feel something? You should act upon it.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
A small report~ It's not just to admire and do nothing, right?
Surely... there's a reason why you're traveling with us.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: By the way, did the VIP feel uncomfortable with non-fair use of the First Class? The start is uncomfortable, but the rest of the journey will be smooth.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: When I went by train, that felt like more First Class. Was it a good experience?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The VIP is getting familiar with us, it will give him some inspiration. Ahahaha.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: We should hurry up.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The VIP wants to be economical. I understand. Let me explain our plan as economically as possible.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Here at Lighthalzen, the downtown and the slums coexist with one another. Both sides has structures that make it hard to easily cross the railway from the side to the other.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Normally, we'd all be issued a pass to go around freely, but we don't have time for now this is the best I've managed to prepare.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What is that?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh, don't worry it's kind of a free pass for our agents. Of course, you don't need to know more.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now we should go to the <NAVI>[slums]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I've found where to go next. Let's go over to the<NAVI>[slums]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Let's go to the headquarters. The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: This is Pat's home. This is where Pat first got into contact with Rekenber and met a staff member.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Pat probably worked hard to get a chance out of poverty and live a better life. He wanted to start anew.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Heyo! There you are. Mom, Dad, how are you?

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: Who...?

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Oh, he's the one who's been searching for Patrick a while ago.

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: Aah, that's you! Did you meet... with Pat?

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Why'd you think they lose someone who was doing well in the Enterprise?

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: No, something is definitely not right! He's not the type of person that would ^0000FFjust stop contacting us.^000000

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: If you're not too busy, perhaps you could keep looking! I'm doing everything to send the paychecks all the way!

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text:
Eh? Of course that's important!
It's how we're able to provide for Pat. But it's strange we haven't heard back from him yet.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Heeey~ Mom, don't fight with Dad.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I came here with a very high ^0000FFimportant^000000 member of your son's company. What did I tell you the other day? He's came to see the welfare of the families who have hired special talent.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Hello~ Is this him?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yes, that's him. You can ask him questions as much as you'd like. He came here for this sole reason.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Hello~ I don't really know where to begin... Thank you for taking in my son, my family isn't worried having enough food to survive anymore. Thank you, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: You may think my son isn't worthy but he's very good at fixing things.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Thanks to the employment, I have a job and can feed my family now. I take pride in it.

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: But, we don't even know if he's alive or not.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: I wonder whether or not I should go to the company and ask for him directly, I'm busy at work and I can't contact him.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: I don't want to get in trouble with the company, I told my son to follow orders and not complain.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: If there's a problem on how things are going, please let us know. From his childhood, he's always been listening closely and he can fix anything.

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: Please honey! You're not asking the important questions. Is there any regulation prohibiting my son from contacting us? I haven't contacted since the day my child was hired, I can't even contact him myself...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There are no regulations to restrict personal contact. We also pay holidays based on the government's recommendation... Your son says he's on vacation.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: So you mean to say Patrick wouldn't even come visit us?

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't like us anymore... ^0000FFOn my first vacation^000000, I just came back to my family and talked to them.

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text:
Oh, I can do that when I'm at work!
What the hell are you doing with the Enterprise people! How come it's gone this far!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Gosh! Mom, Dad! Thank you! So you can't even contact him, aren't you curious what's happening with him? I'm sure you are.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We'll meet with your son, keep going with our investigation and then contact you. You can both trust me and wait. You believe me right?

scripts.speaker: Mother
scripts.text: Oh my~ I can't believe it. Thank you so much. I'm afraid it will be hard for us to contact you...

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Aaah~ how to contact you! No matter what! Please contact us again, even if we're busy!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Okay. Then we'll get going!

scripts.speaker: Father
scripts.text: Take care!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Did you hear all of that? As stated in the documents, they never even got a call after he joined the Enterprise. Well, I don't like seeing them like that, but I have to keep my first tourist promise.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'm sure the employees don't come visit their home during their vacations. Isn't it a ^0000FFprivacy matter^000000 that is none of our business?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: And you think it's like that for everyone in these documents? No way? Pat is a family person, do you really think he wouldn't come back home when he's on vacation because of personal problems? Do you really believe that?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: How about you, guard?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Are you asking me?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yes, you. Your guard doesn't look like someone who enjoys sitting in a hotel, so how about you? Don't you meet with the people you know during your vacations?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes, I often meet with my family during my vacations, sometimes even my friends.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: See? I knew it. Who wouldn't do that? Okay sure. Maybe one guy out of ten.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: The company doesn't investigate private matters. It's private for a reason. Ask yourself if you'd want someone else to look into your private matters.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Aah~ Do you want to meet with them for a few more minutes~ Will the VIP come here again?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I think I heard as much as I need to here. We'll find the rest of the information in the headquarters.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The people who made these documents don't know anything about Pat. It's not just one or two persons on this list. Should you really listen to one person?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Aren't you tired of walking this path narrow, steep path?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Are you tired already? There are people like this everyday. As your people suffer, more people suffer, so much that you can't even recognize pain.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Are you giving me orders?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hello~ I'm just a tourist guide, how can I give you orders. The judgment is done by the VIP's intellect, reasoning and conscience~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next location will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next place will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Adventurer! You're here! Who else would it be?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: You're finally here. Am I too fast for you? Or do you think perhaps it's because the VIP's shoes are not suited for long distances?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We're finally here at Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
When Pat stood in front of the building, he was probably relieved.
The job in the slums wasn't that much different than the one at Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Protester
scripts.text: Rekenber, ^0000FFexplain!^000000

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Explanation?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Ah! Well done. I wanted to introduce her to you. She's the fiance of ^0000FFanother missing person^000000 on the list.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Her fiance was hired by the Rekenber, and then she wasn't able to contact him anymore. Of course, she tried to contact the company and asked what was going on, but what did they tell her?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hey Eva! Hello! Come over here, over here!

scripts.speaker: Protester
scripts.text: Daisy? Hi. Do you have more information on what happened?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh, that? I don't know yet, but I came here with the Vice President to find out.

scripts.speaker: Protester
scripts.text: The Vice... President? This person?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Yeah, that's right. You have something to tell him? Go ahead!
This will be good, I don't regret getting out of bed today!

scripts.speaker: Eva
scripts.text: What happened to Marcus? Give me my Marcus back! It's been 2 years since I haven't heard from Marcus!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You're looking for Marcus? Mar...cus... Holzman. He's from the East of Lighthalzen...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh, what a coincidence. He's also from the Lighthalzen slums!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't want to contact you anymore?

scripts.speaker: Eva
scripts.text: Marcus would never do that to me! My Marcus... Marcus...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: No matter what the truth is, I don't know a third person with the same issue as yours.

scripts.speaker: Eva
scripts.text:
Even if Marcus's thoughts about me had changed, he's not the only one!
Most of the people from the slums that are hired by the Rekenber ^0000FFcannot be reached anymore.^000000

scripts.speaker: Eva
scripts.text:
Do you really think everyone would change their minds like that? To their family? Their friends? Even lovers? It's a bigger issue!
What the hell did Rekenber do with their employees?!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I would like to know more details about this. Let's go back. If we make a disturbance here, they'll call the police.

scripts.speaker: Eva
scripts.text:
What? Do you want to throw me out?
Am I a problem to you? Do you think I'll give up easily? I will keep coming until I find Marcus!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: She said he saw the VIP...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What are you trying to say?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: You're a VIP. You're so beautiful, I'm very impressed. Tsk. Tsk. Tsk.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Listen carefully. As I said before, joining Rekenber is the envy of most people in the slums. If you can't imagine how excited it is for them, then maybe you can't think.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: For such people, Rekenber has been giving out special gifts as part of social welfare, don't you know about it. Rekenber is tricking people.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Are you disrespecting the company's welfare business? I get the same treatment as those who have been specially selected.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: That's not what I'm saying VIP. The secretary here knows too. Do you really not know? Are you pretending?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Have you seen Rekenber's criteria for their special offer?
People who have healthy body and no families. Among them, why would they only pick the poorest?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: What do you think this means? Why only people with good health~ or no money~ then they disappear only to get paychecks to their house~

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: But there's a single missing person around me.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Woah, is that really surprising?
You're a guard? Your guard is from the borders of Rune-Midgard, right?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: How did you know that?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: It's easy to recognize a person from their personality and their tone of voice. It's easy for anyone to know, but I can see it just by looking at your face.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Speaking of personalities, I'm like a guard myself and our spirits can't be broken. You can't break me like a wheel, I'll fight back.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I would rather use force than make compromises.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hah! That's it, that's the spirit. The type that day to day! You would have never allowed your friends to have gone missing just like that. Your personality is what saved our guard, for now anyway.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Anyway do you have a special unit in your guard? I know the answer already.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes... we do.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
I knew it. The VIP says you all get the same treatment. But he won't give security to the people of the slums.
The people in your team are the kind of people who don't go missing.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Simply because it's more troublesome to make a guard disappear. It makes more noises.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: With the money and the welfare paychecks, isn't it easier to just make someone disappear from a vulnerable family and then make their voices unheard?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Do you even know what you're insinuating now? It's all speculations!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you really know what I'm thinking?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Come in and check it out yourself!
Let's see why they never made contact. I don't know what they did during their vacations, but we can see where they are now.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hah, this guy, he's still all about privacy. Are statistics and odds not part of the economy? Why do all of these people go and never contact their house again?
Why are they giving their salaries?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Our adventurer asked a good question. They are almost all from the slums. In Rekenber, they offer you accommodations, with meals and lodging, you hardly have to spend any money at all.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: If the adventurer is from a poor family, and you have to support it, would you spare money for your meals?
I would send everything.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: These accommodations for the low-income classes is Rekenber's contribution to society. We do our best!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Ahah! Was I not polite enough? Our VIP is getting angry~ But the adventurer and I have gone to many places before, we know these things.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
It's an illegal laboratory. You know what an illegal laboratory is?
It would be used for illegal experiments with human life? Used like a lab rats?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Aren't you imagining too much now.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Our guard here and the VIP are not imaginative? I know you don't see to look at what's in front of you, but look at the reality of the situation here.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you know what your colleagues ate and what they were doing before the day was over?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Did the VIP know about the disappearance of his employees until I pushed to investigate about it?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I still cannot conclude that they're missing.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Alright, I see. Let's call it a problem, not a missing person. Do you feel better then? If it makes it easier for you, I'll call it that. Do you even want to solve this problem in a positive light?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Of course.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Perfect, I had hoped you'd say that. I'm glad to see you're not angry anymore. So open your mind~ don't get angry~ breath slowly~ exhale~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: If you're right, then let's check it out at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Come on, get inside the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Hello, how may I help you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We've finally enter the Rekenber's headquarters. I wonder if Pat was relieved when he first passed through this door. Where did he go next?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Do all employees go through OT?
I thought they would assign them to their department directly.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Ah yes, you're right. For the special talented people, they must go through OT first and then they are assigned to their own respective department.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Why is that?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: It's a system based on their ^0000FFplace of origin^000000. There are many people who are not familiar with the corporate culture. After many trials and errors, the new employees are now required to go through OT.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Let's go the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where Pat started his life at Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: I think the others went to the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, where the meetings are held. Shouldn't you be going?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Do you need an assistance with something?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Let's ask this guy for information.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you know Kaufmann? Patrick Kaufmann.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Who are you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The Vice President is looking for Kaufmann.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: I see, what is the purpose. And... who are you again?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Are you the secretary of the Vice President?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: What are you talking about? Did your secretary get hit on the head? You sound like an outsider?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'm looking for Patrick Kaufmann.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: You, who are you... ? I've seen that face before... are you...?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: He is your Vice President.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Aaah! Yes, right, right!!! ...Vice President? Oh, hello!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Do you know anything about Patrick Kaufmann?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
Patrick Kaufmann... I know him. He's a good friend of mine. He has rough hands but his work is fast and accurate.
I tried to keep him around longer, but they took him to the lab.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: The laboratory? Was it Regenschirm?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Yes, there. The newcomers must be in the company for ^0000FFat least a whole year^000000 before they can be sent to another department or a new workplace, unless they are given a ^0000FFspecial request.^000000

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: But why would I send newcomers in the first place? I ignored the requests even though it came from above. But even so, some of the newcomers here were sent elsewhere anyway.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Why?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
Well you see... I need more people for repairs. There's always something broken, so I always need more manpower. But recently,
There's been ^0000FFa  lot more workforce requested.^000000

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you know why so many people were drafted?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
I don't know for sure. Many people in our department get injured while working, and our newcomers are all very strong.
They only take those who are ^0000FFvery good at their job.^000000

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: But if you are pressured from above, you have to abide and give them the workforce, right?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Which laboratory were they sent to?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
The annex one. Oh, do you want to go? I haven't been there in a while, it's quite hard to get inside. If you don't mind, could you send people back here?
Anyway, please be careful, it is a dangerous place.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Ooh.. You cannot be transferred at least until a whole year, unless you are given ^0000FFan unusual request.^000000
But Pat didn't get neither one of these reasons. Is it really a laboratory?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Did you know this VIP? was there anything about this in your documents? Why did the lab only take healthy and you people?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I need to know why they broke the contract rules.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I was in charge of Regenschirm, but I've never seen Patrick Kaufmann.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yeah? You're getting curious too now, aren't you! Is that right?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I will guide you, follow me. Let's go to <NAVI>[Regenschirm]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: They are waiting for you at the <NAVI>[laboratory]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, shouldn't you go as well?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: There doesn't seem to be any room left.

scripts.speaker: Secretary
scripts.text: Hey, where are you going!
Are you talking to us?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Adventurer, let's go quickly? Let's go together.

scripts.speaker: Secretary
scripts.text:
You came all the way to the office, what's going in? You left me alone in here and then just disappeared.
Why are you sneaking in?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you know who's the gentlemen next to me?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Yes, he is my secretary.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Ah! Nice to meet you. My name is Daisy. I'm an old friend of the Vice President.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text:
Hello there. I'm called Gray Earl.
I'm usually not in these places, we should continue this meeting in the Vice President's office.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You don't have to. Here will be just fine. What are you doing in this place anyway? Were you waiting for someone?

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Yes, I noticed something odd about the Vice President's absence, so I went out to see what was going on.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If you keep waiting outside like that, don't you think it looks even more suspicious?

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text:
So you were hiding on purpose. Can you tell what this was all about?
Why all the secrecy?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: That was our plan. I'm cooperating with these people.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text:
Cooperating.. with them..?!
I didn't think we'd be friends with these people again.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Why? Can't we be friends? You! You'll have to explain yourself!

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: You don't seem that old.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You don't need to know more about this. The less you know, the better. When we finish the investigation, we'll let you know.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Yes, sir.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: So, do you know who's in charge of moving the workforce from one department to another? Is it someone you trust?

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Do you want the employee transfer logs? They are kept in the document storage room.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: If you want to uncover secrets, it would wiser to straight to the document storage room and search for the documents yourself than going through the Human Resource department.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Let me tell you where you can find these trustworthy documents.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I know already.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text:
Alright, then please be careful.
There are many eyes around here. You know what I mean, right?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Let's go the <NAVI>[Document Storage Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Go to the <NAVI>[Document Storage Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, go quickly before someone notice you.

scripts.speaker: Gray
scripts.text: Don't you have something else to do.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Hello, this is the document storage room.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Ah! I see. You're looking for Patrick Kaufmann's transfer logs?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Yes, that's why we're here. Have you found what we're looking for?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Patrick Kaufmann. Transfer Code 12-4332.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
He was working as part of the facility maintenance department and then transferred to a new facility.
It says the director, McDonald, came here directly and gave a list of people to transfer.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Do you still have that list?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Oh, that? Wait a minute...

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Oh, there it is. I found it.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Daisy, can you compare the list please.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hmm.. there are many overlap with the names from both lists. I expected as such... but I'm confused.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Does Kaufmann still work at McDonald's laboratory?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
Well... the fact is, some of the facility maintenance employees work outside of the labs.
Patrick was from the same department, so maybe it was the same for him.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I've been told we are not allowed to transfer people until at least a whole year, but what is the reason why Kaufmann was transferred?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Well... there's reason to do that here. Once a request is received from the lab, we approve it. It's a top priority.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: So where is Kaufmann right now?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: As I told you before, I work around the clock... there are many laboratories here and there, I'm not sure which ones are still operational or not.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
We don't keep track of all the trips and movements inside the headquarters. I hear a lot, though.
The detailed records can be found inside the lab he is in, or another lab perhaps.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: How was his vacations? Did he rest well?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: On vacation... he has already used all of his days. Well... he drove out at the end of the year.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: And where did he go during his vacations? I already know the answer, but there is someone here who doesn't believe me.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: We do not control how and where the employees spend their private time.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Just one more check. Marcus Holzman is on the list. Where is he working now?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Let's see, Marcus Holzman? Wait...

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Well, Holzman went to Sinclair's laboratory.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Did he use all of his vacations as well?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Yes... He drove out at the end of the year and use all of his vacations days...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Where is the laboratory?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text:
Let's see... the lab is on the outside of Einbroch's outer zone.
McDonald lab is located at ^0000FFSector 01 - Section 95-146 in the Einbroch Mountains^000000 and Sinclair's lab is located at Zone 11 - Sector 45-156 in the Einbroch Mountains.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: And there it goes. Of course. I also know the answer, but I'll ask you anyway, are Patrick and Marcus still working at Rekenber?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Of course. They are being paid for work. If you leave, you wouldn't get paid anymore, right?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Of course, that's common sense~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now let's head to these new laboratories. There's probably a lot more we can find out over there.
How are we doing this?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We can all go together. We came here for this reason.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: How about we save some time and share information afterwards? Let's split and meet again at a specific location.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
That's a good idea. Then me and you will go to Sinclair's laboratory together.
The adventurer will go to McDonald's laboratory with the VIP. When we finish the investigation, we'll meet you back over at McDonald's lab.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Why? Why am I going with you? Isn't it better for me to go back with the Vice President?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Have you forgotten? The Vice PResident wants to do this operation as unbiased as possible.
Would you believe the findings of me and the adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you want to give the Vice President a reason to be suspicious? We can't allow that?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'm fine with Daisy's idea. It makes the most sense.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Vice President! The reason I'm here is to protect you!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I won't say it twice.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Let's go now. You're heading for the <NAVI>[McDonald Laboratory]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, wait for us when you're done.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Please have a look. If you need anything, let me know!

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: <NAVI>[McDonald Laboratory]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is located in Einbroch, at the outer zone. Please be careful, it is a dangerous area.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: If you have a document or a book to find, please go see the staff member at the reception.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: This place is restricted from outsiders, please leave.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hello. Okay, you're busy so that you don't know when someone died? So what happened? Don't you think its a big deal?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: Everyone, please come out.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Hello, Med. I've been looking forward to meeting you again.

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text: Aas? Oh my, is it really you Aas? Are you okay? What are you doing here? Are you go to question someone who's betrayed us and changed sides?

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text:
Are you going to arrest these traitors, cruelly torture them, and make them reveal all their sins?
This is like a spy novel!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I didn't come for that. Have you seen a facility maintenance employee by the name of Patrick Kaufmann? Where is he now?

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text:
Pa... who? Patrick Kaufmann? Who is that? I don't know... oh! have you asked <NAVI>[Sammy]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>?
Sammy would know more. He manages the workforce here. You should go meet him.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Thank you for your help. Keep on rebuilding this lab.

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text: And would you like to tell me who you are?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: These people don't even know the face of the Vice President they work for.

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text: Ah!! That's you, I'm so sorry! I'll do my best!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: We should go <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> now~

scripts.speaker: Med
scripts.text: If you want more information, you should ask <NAVI>[Sammy]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> at the entrance.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: This place is restricted from outsiders, please leave.

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: What are you doing here? You can't be here unless you have an appointment.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Hey, Sammy. Could I ask you a few questions?

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: Aas? What are you doing here...?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Good afternoon. We want to ask you a few questions.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: What do you want to ask me?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: This is the Vice President, here with us.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: Vice President?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes, this is the Vice President, Kaya Tos.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Kaya Tos.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: Oh my, Vice President. What are you doing in such a place... oh, what do you want to know?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Oh wow, look at the attitude change. All we had to do was say the magic words : Vice President.
That was too easy.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I should probably use it more often from now on?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'd like to know where Patrick Kaufmann is. He is a facility maintenance employee who was sent here.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: Pa... Patrick Kaufmann... Patrick... Well... Ah! I remember!

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: ... and then he was sent to another laboratory.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You aren't supposed to relocate new employees for at least a whole year, why are you constantly asking for more workforce?

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: Yeah...? Why are we being sent so many? I have ^0000FFnever asked or more manpower in the building^000000. When new people arrive here, I assume they're simply a transfer.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text:
So when Pat came here, I thought he was also a transfer. Especially at the time, because of the new research facility, the maintenance and logistic department teams...
^0000FFwere transferring people a lot.^000000

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Where is the location of the transfer laboratory?

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text:
I don't know the exact location.
It's somewhere at the ^0000FFEinbroch's outer zone.^000000 I've heard many new facilities involve dangerous experiments that can't be done in the city, so workforce is sent outside.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text:
But... maybe... was there another reason for the transfers? What...
What happened to the people?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: A new laboratory... I couldn't investigate it. It's a new laboratory that needs a lot of people, but I wasn't able to find it. What do you think? Can you smell us getting closer?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: This is certainly not in the papers I've received. There were only mentions of departures and few transfers. All the details were missing.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
They wrote it like that on purpose,
someone with enough suspicious would have figured out the truth.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Perhaps someone didn't want you to learn the truth and deliberately removed those details. Otherwise it would have been shown in the original documents.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: A new facility... I must find out where it is. There might be more things we don't know about.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: You keep going on and on and on. If someone dies, I have to confirm it with my own eyes.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Let's get more information from the <NAVI>[Office]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Are you going to the Human Resources?
I've already been there.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: How deeply did you investigate the Enterprise?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Oh no~ you still think I'm a liar.
Where else will you find someone as trustworthy as I am?
What did you just say?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
One of the employee here said that one of my very distant relative passed away and left a big legacy.
I wasn't able to reach him, and then I came here looking for what was left for me.
You believed him?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Why not? Does the adventurer have any relatives? I don't know...
Romance and thrills, hehe. We've always waited for this dream to happen.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Oh...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Does your guard know some romance?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There's no time for this, let's go.

scripts.speaker: Sammy
scripts.text: I didn't mean to cover up anything, it's just what I heard. Did everyone else went to the <NAVI>[Office]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>?

scripts.speaker: Staff
scripts.text: What are you doing here? You can't be here unless you have an appointment.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Do you know why we're here?
Daisy, what are you thinking?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: This place is inappropriate for the Vice President. It's hard to guard. People can easily flock together.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Who knew that there was such a place.
It's more amazing than you think.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I've been waiting for you.
This place is a bit chaotic, but the Rebellions rather like it here.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: This place will be used as a base while you carry out your other duties.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Anyhow, I've analyzed all the information gathered from the last operation.
It turns out there are more facilities with secret laboratories.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
We already expected as much when we started our research.
It's not just speculation this time, the evidence is clear now.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Elena Volkova is organizing an recon team for investigating the suspected areas.
I think it would greatly help if you joined her team too..

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Hey~ Tes!
We sent a recon team to investigate the areas you spoke about.
Where is it?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Oh you're the adventurer? Did Tes call you?
It really help if someone as strong as you joined us.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Are you really sure about this place?
Lucky said it's just an abandoned smelting plant after a mine close.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I know it doesn't look like much,
but thanks to the previous data collected by the Werner Institute...
We found an entry to the ^4D4DFFAbandoned Waste of Rudus^000000.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: We figured out a path or a location to get inside, so I'd like you to investigate it further.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Anyway, so this area with all the experiments?
Then I'll go to the field.
The adventurer should come after me.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Then I'll inform the adventurer of your location separately.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Leave it to me.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Why not join us and see the situation for yourself?
The location is Einbroch North-East field. The code name for the operating system is Rudus.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I'll call this location <NAVI>[Rudus]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> from now on.
I would be grateful if you joined.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
In the meantime, I will try and learn more about Lighthalzen.
You should received enough information to start investigating now.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
<NAVI>[Rudus]<INFO>ein_fild05,158,284,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is at Einbroch North-East field.
If you join the recon team, it will definitely help.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
You went there?
Hmm, so you've found in the barrier in the closed mine, and there are monsters behind it?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I don't think it's a research facility, even by looking at the other member's report.
It seems to be a place to cover up unsuccessful experiments.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
For some reason, there's been no accident on the outside. Tsk.
For the time being, I think I'm going to split from the rebellions.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Unfortunately, Rudus didn't bring out great results. Volkova has been quite helpful.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I'll have to go to the backdoor now room now.
It seems I've picked up bad customers, but with the adventurer's help it shouldn't be a problem.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
It's that room over there. It's a place where only rebellions leaders can go in or out.
All the captains are inside.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
It's the building at the top left of our Headquarters, in <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,56,270,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
There will be Rekenber guards sent by Aas and troop dispatched by the republic.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Est will also be there, you'll find the location easily.
I hope this mission goes well.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
You're back.
Est came back first and I wasn't sure something had happened to you.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
The information I got from Est was incredible.
And it seems Lazy has something to tell you.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Kaya should be there too.
I have to analyze the data everyone is giving me, it's piling up.
You have enough to do already.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Is it related to the laboratory's security.
Aas told me you had something to deliver.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I think it's a conscious decision from Schlein to have left these documents.
Tsk, that Schlein.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I understand.
I will analyze this along with the other materials.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Lazy seems to be up to something.
He's somewhere here in the pub, go and find him.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I thought you were investigating with Lazy, it looks like you didn't get great results.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I finished analyzing the information you gathered from Regenschirm earlier, there were traces of supplies and research data.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
So far, I believe it was a trick from the Enterprise, from those who sit back at the company.
Huh...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I agree with your assessment.
The more I learn about the truth, the less I understand what's going on.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
What I've seen so far was only the tip of the iceberg.
My eyes are now wide opened.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
It seems it was from the group that pretended to be part of the security personnel and then attacked the laboratory.
What could their motives be?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Tsk, I think I know who's behind all of this.
There have only been a few people who have ran unreasonable experiments at the laboratory.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: We had fired them because of their unethical experiments, I'm guessing it's them.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Hmm... That part of the investigation still needs more clarity.
I'm going to try and find more information about the new laboratories.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I will leave this part to you.
I'm going back to my laboratory and do some research.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Please excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: ... then I'll keep you informed about the next operation.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
There is another closed mine at Einbroch, in the North-West region.
There are many abandoned mines in the area...

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I should have looked at them more, but I don't have enough resources...

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Anyway, this time around, the elders of the Rebellion are going to participate in the operation.
They are very strong supporters.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Meet with a <NAVI>[Rebellion Crew]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> member at the North-West region of Einbroch.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Meet with a <NAVI>[Rebellion Crew]<INFO>ein_fild03,278,269,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> member at the North-West region of Einbroch.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I'm a bit tired. There are tons of documents to analyze.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
It's your operation. Do you have no support available?
How the hell you become a government without an army?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I can't say anything about that.
I don't have the authority to create and grow my own army.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
I know. I can't ask that to a general soldier.
You don't have the power to change that.
Why are you all here?!

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Right? Isn't it weird for you too?
It's really strange for us as well, are you aware of what's going on adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: It's impressive how they've managed to make this meeting inside the pub will all of us, and now a Rebellion unit is helping out the Enterprise.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Isn't it truly wonderful and amazing? I've seen many things, but I never thought that this day would come.
But why are you here?

scripts.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
scripts.text:
Sigh.. I don't know why we're so hostile with each other.
Still, there are only few organizations that contribute to the people...

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Do you really believe so?
Don't you know why we're called the Rebellion in the first place?
You're only thinking about what you want.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Yeah. That's a corporation. How many companies do you have now?
Your president always look down on us.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
That's not it, Est.
You do know there's a reason for that, right?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
I've already decided to send a support unit.
Even so, is that really going to be enough?
So what's going on?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: I'm a little too excited. I'll shut up. Tes, explain it please.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
To put it simply, our affiliated Enterprise research institute, Regenschirm, is occupied by a large group of enemies.
A special unit under Est's command will be dispatched for the recapture.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: So that's why Est was so nervous.
Why aren't the Enterprise guards helping?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Well you see...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
It all started because of the traitor within the guards.
Oh, sorry, I'm senior Rekenber security officer, Aas.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: The traitor is the chief security officer, Schlein, who has substantial support within the guard forces.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
It's these guards, let by Schlein,
Who currently occupies the Regenschirm.
Most of the armed forced join with Schlein, and they started calling themselves Heart Hunters.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Yes. It was the Heart Hunters.
On the day of the incident, at midnight, the guards changed uniform for something unusual.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: In the daytime, our team is in charge of patrols and security. At nighttime, the security guards of Schlein take over.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: The shifts scheduled for that day came in wearing new uniforms, it was a mistake for me to believe it was an experimental outfit.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
They seized the daytime crew in an instant.
With their deception, they took all over the security guards simultaneously.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
I tried to send an emergency request to get a response team, but they are extraordinarily strong...
Only more guards ended up being sacrificed and we didn't have any success.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
And the one responsible for this was Schlein, showing up in a new uniform.
He asked me if I wanted to become stronger. If I accepted his offer, I would become a Heart Hunter too.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
I refused and left, only to watch more guards suffering.
Most of my crew suffered huge casualties, as I just stood by in shame...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
The guards wearing the new uniform, who followed Schlein, may not have all been Heart Hunters.
Schlein only gathers the strongest people after all.
I've met Heart Hunters too...

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Did you see any more Heart Hunters?
Weren't those guards we fought in the battlefield some time ago?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
If our opponents are Heart Hunters, that's interesting.
I should be able to handle them quickly.
I'll go first.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: There, what do you say Aas?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes? Yes! How can I help you with that?

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Couldn't you just have said that?
Are you afraid of these guards?
Don't you think we should go now, after you tell us the way?
Come on? Like the first operation we did.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Yes. I see. You're right.
I should go and explain the situation in more details...

scripts.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
scripts.text:
Don't worry about me.
Is it safe for me to stay here?
I have something I must do. You do what you have to do on your end.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Roger. Then I will discuss strategies with Est.

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text: Tes, watch out your back. Haha, you'll be alright.

scripts.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
scripts.text:
It all went so fast.
I wish we could talk more in-depth about this operation.

scripts.speaker: Middle-Aged Man
scripts.text: I don't think I should be starting this conversation, so why do not you speak with Tes instead?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Now I can formally introduce myself.
My name is Kaya. I work with the Rekenber Division.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There aren't a lot of security personal remaining in the Enterprise, because most of them betrayed Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
So now, the rest of us are doing our best to shutdown Regenschirm...
I've sent help requests here and there, but I haven't gotten a good replies yet.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: An unusually large number of companies have contacted the Rekenber directly for support.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: But as a general soldier in the Schwartz Republic, it was too difficult to handle it ourselves and eventually we took advantage of the Rebellion and the adventurer's strength.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I can understand why Est was so angry.
There are many people who are blind to the corrupt management and others who work on their own accord.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I've came here to purge the evil from the Enterprise.
However, I hadn't realize these rotten people were so deeply connected in politics.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
The citizen's safety is threatened,
they don't know what the enterprise is thinking. Neither can they officially seek and request help.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Sigh, wait.
You're not wrong, of course, but there are separate reasons for this.
It look like your sister has made some kind of deal with the president.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: No, it wouldn't have been necessary to make such a deal if the right people were governing in the first place!

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Don't you think if the Enterprise had managed its properly to begin with, we wouldn't be in this situation right now?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
.....
I'm sorry, I got worked up.
With our plan in action, I believe we have a better future ahead of us.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
I agree, we have to act quickly though.
So {0},
If possible, could you join Est and do some planning?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
As said they were called 'Heart Hunters'.
Maybe there is a connection with the previous incident. There maybe additional information we can send to Rune-Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Kaya and I will stay here to process and relay the incoming information.
I will leave the battle side of things to you and Est.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Please take care.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I'll see you outside.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I'm sorry I can't help you anymore.
I think it may turn into a messy fight.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Oh, hello there! My name is Aas from the Rekenber Security.
I'm currently here as Kaya Tos's bodyguard

scripts.speaker: Est
scripts.text:
Why should we help them?
Can you explain why we have to cooperate with them?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Look, that's all nice and good to have ^0000CDfacts^000000. But this is not even something you can use as a firepower.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I've said it a few times already.
This is it, those are all the ^0000CDfacts.^000000

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Truth be told, it doesn't sound convincing. If I look at the front page of your report, it does not at all align with my investigation results.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If that's the case, then we should review the investigation methods and the credibility of the source.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh sure, I have a lunch menu survey from the people in the neighborhood... is that what you want to use as facts?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: That's not what I said at all...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: What, you don't believe me? Yeah? Is that it? You don't think it's a reliable source of information?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Isn't it common sense that ^0000CDpeople inside the Enterprise know more?^000000
Not only would we have access to more data, but the quality would be much higher than what's available to an outsider.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Don't you think the Vice President would only share with us ^0000CDwhat he want us to know?^000000
Am I supposed to suspend all critical thinking and unquestioningly believe you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Won't that mean you can just report to the President and hide a plan from us? Yeah? Right?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I never said that.
Lazy, what's wrong?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Adventurer? Adventurer!! Hey, I haven't died yet!! Never been better!!
Listen to me.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Lazy? Is your name Lazy? Didn't you introduce yourself as Daisy?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh, that? Don't worry about it, it's the name I use to distract people. There, now you know me. Oh by the way... never mind, you don't need to know that.
If it's Daisy... are you a flower?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Look, although it may be true in my case, it doesn't mean it applies to me.
Don't take it too personal. Who in the world only has one name?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If you don't have anything else to say, then please explain why your name is different.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
I was born to talk about it, but who are you talking about?
I have so many things to talk about. I can talk about them all day long.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now, as you know, this conversation is business meeting, aren't the Vice President's underlings standing right behind you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: It's already known to our neighbors that Rekenber was performing illegal experiments. Maybe the people on this list could have also been involved.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Don't you want to clear their suspicions? Get their cooperation to know what's in your backyard?
If it were up to me, I'd have done that already. When else would we get such an opportunity?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
What more are you hiding in your backyard? Are you not here for asking our help? If there's anything hidden over there,
wouldn't the Vice President be in trouble?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Requesting help and analyzing paperwork are separate matters.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Is it a separate matter because you said so? When did you decide that?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now this has turned into a matter of trust, not merely a question about people missing!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Until we deal with these documents, how do you expect us to trust you?
Why would you assume so? Nobody here believe you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: So here's the real question! How can we really cooperate with you if we don't have trust between us?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
These are the official documents from the Rekenber investigation.
Whether you believe it or not, Daisy, I don't know how else to clear your doubts.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
So you searched into the Enterprise very thoroughly and your information is ^0000CD100% reliable.^000000
So we have to believe it unconditionally. Isn't that strange? Do you have no evidence?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I mean, if this document is credible at anyway, then you're calling me a liar, Vice President!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh... this is sudden. Should I seek the cooperation of the Vice President after I've been called a liar?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I never called you a liar...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: No that's not it. You're requesting our cooperation, and asking us to trust you completely without any real evidence. How can we believe you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now, even if you actively cooperate with me, it's hard for me to like trust this arrangement.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You're repeating yourself now. I assure you, you can trust the documents.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Why would I believe in you if you don't believe in me? I'm a compassionate person, patient and very humane.
Are your eyes so shut that you can't see what's in front of you?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Now you're going too far!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Don't worry, it's alright. You know it's all true.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Why, what's the matter with you?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
