scripts.text: Vice President, do you think that's right?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
No? Well that's alright with me.
I'm fine.
I'm not blind. Even in my position, I've noticed the Enterprise is hiding something from us!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Anyway, Vice President, I know how people like you are, I'll give my report and I'll do things my own way.
Eh? Lazy? Where are you going!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Ah, this is frustrating!
Adventurer! Listen to me! Listen to me and you'll be the judge of who's right. You know what these guys have been saying?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Now, look at this ^0000CDpile of documents^000000 over here. You don't have to read it too carefully. Just look at the cover.
Rekenber... missing list..?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yeah. It's a list of ^0000CDmissing people^000000 who used to work at Rekenber. I've investigated everything as much as I could.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Even though I'm acquainted with the information, it's impossible to go deeper inside the Enterprise.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: If I wanted to do this, I was cautioned to proceed legally to avoid causing more frictions.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I believe the president has a relationship with the government and its businesses. So they have think carefully about this matters.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: So when I met Kaya, I asked him to cooperate with me. You can help us in the yard, right?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Because he's a Rekenber official, it should be easy for him to find this information right?
Right.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: But, well, I need you to check this out and cooperate with the investigation. You know how I get when I get thrown paper from the head office.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
The employees on the list are assigned to another work station and they're in constant rotation.
Payments are also confirmed to be monthly basis.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: It's just common sense, why would a company go out their way to pay a salary to an unemployed person?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
I'm telling you it's common sense~
I can say common sense in front of people who have studied hard~

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Wait, did I misunderstand the meaning of common sense?
Did I change the definition without knowing about it?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: So either you're lying here, or I'm the one lying. Adventurer, am I the one lying?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: To sum it all up, we've lost many contacts to Rekenber's employees. Nobody really knows what happened to them.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
But they have such a long history?
The government just now realized about this issue. There's definitely a connection between that and the missing people. That's why I decided to investigate further.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Who else would do the job if not me? That's why I have to investigate.
I have to do it in very legitimate way, Because I told him I would do it without causing friction.
Are your results any different?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
If you spend a long time as an adventurer, you can add 1 and 1 together. I see the scheme.
Yes, it's real.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yes, that's it. I'd like you to check again to figure out this mystery one and for all.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
That's why ^0000CDI don't do desk jobs^000000.
When I look at papers, I don't know how the world outside is doing.
I prefer going outside on the field and learn with my own eyes.
Do you want to go along with the investigation?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you think these guys who won't listen will go? Will you accompany me to search for the truth?
I'll be back as soon as possible.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: No, no, Adventurer. You don't have to do such a thing. You just need to report the situation to me and do it the way I told you.
Let me speak with them

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yeah, well, if you want to talk, come to me anytime, but don't be too hard on yourself~ the energy and time of the adventurer is important.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I really like it here. Don't forget about the adventure, there's nothing to worry about.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
What did he say? No, right?
See I told you. Persuading him is a waste of time. If you don't cooperate with me, there's no way I can report back to the President.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: His stiffness is stronger than bamboo. He's so rigid that his knees wouldn't bend.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
If you don't cooperate with him and do it my way from now on,
The President will give you permission.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: If you asked the enterprise to cooperate with us, but what are you going to do if they refused?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Hmm. Excuse me.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Have you thought about it?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Please think it over, Vice President!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: This is a waste of time, no matter how I look at it. Even if you told me a hundred times, it's not economical for me to go. But I accept your proposal anyway.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Economical? Of course it's economical. I also like being economical. So, I can do this economically on my own terms? Yeah?
Dear Vice President?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Listen to me. I asked the government for help. I do agree that for us to trust each other, we must fully cooperate with one another.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
If the only way to achieve that is by reviewing the people on the list, I will accept the condition.
^0000CDI will accompany you and actively cooperate.^000000

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Please reconsider, Vice President.
You do not have to do that. I should go instead of you, no?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There is a limit to what you can do. This is my responsibility and mine alone.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you even know how to travel and cooperate?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Good. Let's forget about the past altercation and focus on the future. Thank you Vice President.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: While the rest are analyzing what they've brought from the lab, the Vice President and I will go deal with the list.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Before we go on, there are two ^0000CDtwo conditions^000000 for this joint investigation.
First, please have at least ^0000CDa minimum amount of courtesy.^000000

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Oh, aren't you a ^0000CDVIP^000000?
Okay, thank you very much, VIP.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Is it a hobby of yours to provoke other people?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: If you don't like being called a VIP, then which title do you prefer?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: ... and second, I want a ^0000CDreliable person^000000 in your party.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Why?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I will need a witness in the future.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oh I see, so you don't believe me?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: If that's the requirement, I'll go!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You're already a witness on our side. You can't be a witness.
Then I'll go.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Eh? Why the adventurer? If you're coming along, then you'll get to do all the fun parts...!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
If me, {0} and Daisy are going, it will be a fair investigation.
Will both of our determinations combined, nothing can stop us.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Wait, but what about your guard?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I do not need a guard. I came here by myself the first time around. I will be just fine this time too.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Very thoughtful. But you need to have a guard. It shouldn't be needed, but in case something goes wrong.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Even though I'm a very talented person, I have to prioritize my own safety first.
Look, I can take care of myself, and If I have to, I can tag along with the adventurer, but what about a VIP?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
If you get hurt it will only cause a scandal. It would be bad! You know what I mean, right?
Plus we might not be able to get back right away, so it might get complicated.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes, I'm definitely going!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Well then I'll bring Aas with me...

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Also, it's really economical. Quick decision making, I like it.
So let's start with ^0000CDEinbroch^000000 at the <NAVI>[Airport]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
What are you doing here?.
Let's go to the <NAVI>[Einbroch Airport]<INFO>einbroch,42,208,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
Hello. I'm back is everything fine?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Of course I can spare some time for someone who helped get back the laboratory. I really appreciate it.
But why have you come to see me?
- You explain to Kaya, about what you and Lazy discussed. -

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I understand what you mean, But Daisy's logic ^0000CDis too much^000000. I cannot doubt the ^0000CDcredibility of official documents,^000000 that's not just possible.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I have no intention of debating this further with you, so I'll talk to the person in charge.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Who's the responsible one?
The person in front of me?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The president gave me his full authority on this matter.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: And who are you exactly?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I already told you before, didn't I? Does the Vice President have a bad memory?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Why would I believe a man who gave me a fake name?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: A name is just a name. If I was called Shit, would I become Shit when talking to the Vice President?
Is it your hobby to eavesdrop?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Why? Isn't this where I should be?
Is it bad to listen? Don't bother with them it's not worth your time.
As Lazy was saying... Even if you called Lazy by Shit, Lazy would still be Lazy.
Even if there is someone introduced Lazy as Shit, would you always view him as Shit for the rest of his life?
Now here's what really matters. If you do not tell the truth about what really happened, you'll not be able to get their cooperation.
Vice President, this is all about the Enterprise. Wouldn't it be nice to clear these doubts at once and for all, and show a better image of the Enterprise?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I understand what you're saying, but you're wrong. We are telling you the truth and you're assuming we are lying.
I don't know everything that Lazy knows, but he seems to have better grasp at the situation than you do, Vice President.
Lazy isn't the type of person that would spend time investigating these matter for no reason.
Lazy says he cannot believe the results the Vice President has provided, but do you not believe the results Reiji provided either, correct?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: We'd rather trust our results than those of Daisy.
How about this then? Why don't you two, who don't trust each other, see it for yourselves, together?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Investigate, together?

As Lazy said, he doesn't trust your findings.
If you can't believe in each other results, why don't you guys start from the beginning?
If you both investigate the differences between the reports, you'll know for sure which is accurate. A compromise must be done here.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: That's valid argument. But do I need to go too? I would prefer talking to you.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Can you believe what I've investigated so far? You still can't believe my findings, because you're assuming your documents are correct.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Yeah, no. I didn't think so.
Do you mind?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I can't help it. We're wasting our time with them, why bother? What's wrong? Do you have nothing to say?
Please wait a moment, Lazy

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I don't have much time to wait for this silliness.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: The results will be the same no matter how many times we check them. We have a lot of other work to do.

Vice President, you believe all the people in the Enterprise, right? But what will happen now?
With the current situation, nobody will believe your findings.
If Lazy was wrong after the joint investigation, then you'd simply have wasted a bit of your time, but for the Vice President, it's a huge issue.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: ... Please give me a few minutes to consider my options.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Daisy's opinion is hard to accept, but the logic behind it... is correct. I think I'll give it a try.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Didn't you come here to find Daisy?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Oh, this place is so peaceful.
You look pale.
...
It's a joke, I think I need more time to properly investigate this area.
Is there any problem?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
They said barriers were built because the factory closed.
Something doesn't feel right here though.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Anyway, I should go beyond the barrier to get satisfying information for Tes?
My crew is working on securing the doorway first. If you open it, go check out the other side.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: You remember Lucky? I brought him along, so go ahead and ask him about the progress.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I need to find out what's beyond the barrier.
If there's nothing special, I'll just leave. But if there is something there at all, Should I use my full strength?
Of course, I like the latter.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Have you investigated beyond the barrier?
If something suspicious comes up, Leave it to me!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Now, it's finally Elena Volkova's time to shine!
Adventurer, return to Cat on Bullet and tell Tes what happened here.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
There is no difference whether you report it or someone else does.
This place is just a dump.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
The USU will manage somehow, go ahead and report back to Tes about the situation.
In the meantime, I have to help out my team.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
This area is nothing but a disposal facility.
It's where they throw away their failed experiments.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
It would be great if those guys went outside the barrier.
I haven't trained today!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Are you an adventurer?
Did Tes send you? If you want more information, you'll have to find it yourself.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Would you look at this place?
It's a triple-edged door. I'm having a hard time opening it up.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Of course, if you use magic like Teleport or Fly Wings, you can get past it.
We have a lot of people with us though... *laughs*
Wouldn't you prefer to go in directly with your own two legs?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Other rebellion members are already looking for an entry point. If you don't mind, can you check on them?
Maybe you'll find something out.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: The abandoned mine is beyond this barrier. Be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Other rebellion members are already looking for an entry point. If you don't mind, look for them adventurer.
Maybe you'll find something out.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: The abandoned mine is beyond this barrier. Be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Hey... So you found a watchtower and Small Hole?
A Small Hole so small, that a human couldn't have pass it? Ahaha...
That's too bad.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
If I could use that Small Hole, my efforts would be in vain wouldn't they?
Don't be disappointed!
I finally unlocked this door.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
This button right here opens the door, but the moment you release it, the door closes.
Does that mean there's no way for a single person to cross on the other side?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Even if you come with 2 people...
This is awkward.
It seems to have been made with the intention of 'throwing in'.
Throwing in?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
There is a place like this with similar devices.
A prison. A jail. It's for prisoners... What is this place?!
What is it? Are we in a criminal camp?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
No that's not it. If it was such a facility, Tes wouldn't have known about it.
Well, for now, you should just go in.
I hear suspicious sounds...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Well? Aaah! I heard that. These are strange screams? So the other members went in.
I'll stay here to manage the switch while you go on the other side.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Are you going to join the others too?
If you find the sources of the noises, see monsters, or anything else out of ordinary, please let me know!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
When you want to come out, do 'tock-tock-tock' on the other side and knock on the iron door three times.
I'll open the door from my end.
Of course you can also use magic to get out... Ahaha.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Other rebellion members have already entered.
We can't just leave them alone.
Be careful.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Woah... what happened in there?
You look exhausted...
The monsters came out.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The monsters!?
Let's report to Elena! Then, return to Cat on Bullet and report back to Tes!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Do you think the monsters can get out from the small gap?
I'll stay here and return with Elena in a bit!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: It's nice to suddenly have so much work to do... But I won't be able to do everything on my own...

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Well? Are you involved with the operation?
Even though I live in Einbroch,
This is the first time I've seen it.
What's wrong?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Look over here, is it not strange?
It's a railway to carry minerals, but they've built a barrier on top.
It doesn't even have a door.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
At first I thought this wall was meant to separate the smelting factory and the mine...
But I don't think it is?
Was the barrier created afterwards?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
For sure.
But why do you need a barrier to an already closed mine and factory?
And this type of structure is what's used in prisons.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: I don't know the purpose of this wall, but it was not built while the factory was still running.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
I'll have a closer look and join you later.
Please tell Lucky.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: I have to look a bit more.

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Well? What is the adventurer doing here?
Are you part of the operation too?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
Oh! I'll let you know what I found here.
Do you see this big column?
I went on top of it, the watchtower!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
It looks better than the barrier.
I don't know why there's a watchtower in smelting facility, but it's definitely a watchtower!
This is the discovery of the century. Ahaha!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text:
When I was looking up there, I think I saw something move.
I'm going to make sure of what I saw by going back up!

scripts.speaker: Rebellion Crew
scripts.text: I will learn everything I can about the watchtower! You can report back to Lucky!

There is a small enough hole just barely enough for a child to go through.
It seems like an animal has dug this hole and made a little cave.
Let's have another look around.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Oh!
Are you back already?
Did you find it?
Hand over the picture

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Thank you.
You may think it's not worth much, but it means a lot to me...

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: What's with that expression...?

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text: I've never seen that in the room.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text:
Ahah...
It's a souvenir of us when we were children.
Was it always like that?

scripts.speaker: Ridsh
scripts.text:
Were we really so loud?
Anyway, we've opened the door, let's go.
I think people are coming.

scripts.speaker: Dien
scripts.text: It's been a while since I have been this excited.
Chat with Morning.
Find a meal for Morning.
Chat with Morning.
I'll bring it.
Something urgent happened.
A lot of garbage is piled up around this rock. It seems to have been there for a while too. Let's dig the ground.
Dig.
Quit.
I searched the ground and found a note someone buried.
A lot of garbage is piled up around this rock. It seems to have been there for a while too. Let's dig the ground.
Dig.
Quit.
Someone seems to have already dug this place.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: It's dangerous for you to be in a place like this. Even for experienced people. Please come back next time.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Show me the way out!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: So these gunmen think they can just come here and suddenly start a commotion!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Gentlemen, please don't do this. We didn't come here to harm you.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Of course not. We're just getting attacked by you, rebellions.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Being emotional doesn't help resolve problems.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are you threatening us now?
What's going in?

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Aah! You're alive! Adventurer! Is anyone with you?
I'm the first to arrive...

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: I sent a person to pick the person in charge. We are the Advance Squad who was sent here to search and recon this place, but as you can see...
Who are these people?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Is this the person responsible for all of this?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I don't think so? That person looks dumb.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text:
They are the ^0000CDpeople who's working here^000000.
As you can see, we didn't harm them...

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text:
We really don't know what to do.
There are ^0000FFthe lab workers^000000
who does chores around here, and when we tried to enter they stopped us.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What are you saying does chores?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why do you guys judge the work of others? You aren't in charge, are you?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I think you're just ignorant people who don't know anything.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Come on, they're all gunmen!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: That's not it! We want to protect the civilians and make things right!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: If we refuse to comply, what's gonna happen? Are you going to shoot us?
Why are you blocking the road?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Why not? If someone came into your home, would you just let them in?
These people are out of their minds and are making a mess.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
See! Why are you sticking your nose into other people's business?
That's it! Get out! Get out now!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text:
Perhaps you don't know, but this ^0000FFlab was doing illegal experiments.^000000
We have came to arrest the people responsible in cooperation with the Government and Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What? What do you mean illegal experiments? Can you tell us where these illegal experiments were done?

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: I know it's hard to believe, I'm having a hard time to believe it myself, but this is the place that was used to run illegal experiments.
Who owns this mansion?
I don't see any researchers here.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Perhaps they ^0000FFescaped to the mansion.^000000

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: These people look like the manual workforce, they are not researchers.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: The people and the materials that are left behind in the rush of escaping are likely the good people left.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What are you saying about us?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What? Are we just garbage you can just throw away?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
How many researcher are like us!
They can't keep this place running without us!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Get out now! This is Rekenber's laboratory! You're trespassing on private property!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: What? What are we supposed to do now. We can't use force against unarmed civilians.
I would never hurt you guys.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why should we stand back? You're the invaders!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I don't want anybody to get hurt, you will hurt us with your weapons!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Should we charge in?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Why would you charge in without orders?
Vice President! Tes!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why do you keep coming? Get out! Get out!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: These are employees who help the laboratory run, but they do not believe when I tell them they've been conducting illegal experiments.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Alright. Let me talk to them.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Who are you now?!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: The Vice President wants to talk to them.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Head to the safe location, hurry!

scripts.speaker: Advanced Team
scripts.text: Adventurer, it's dangerous here. Proceed to the safe location.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Hello everyone, I'm Kaya Tos, Rekenber's Vice President.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Vice President? The Vice President?
Isn't that another one of your lies?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Huh? I know him! That is indeed Kaya, The Vice President.
When I was at the headquarters, I saw him a few times.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Oh, really? I didn't know because I had never seen your face before.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why is the Vice President here?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Were you all hired by the Rekenber institute to work on constructing and maintenance in this new lab?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: That's correct.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Yes, I've been hired by Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What did the person wearing blue clothes over here do here?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Me? Well... I'm responsible for making and delivering foods to the people working here.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: And what about the person next to you?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I carry waste materials and laboratory equipment.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If you know what this place is studying, please raise your hand.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Well... renewable energy?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Oh I know! Wasn't it agricultural research?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
It looks like livestock study.
Sometimes strange beasts roam by.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: While you do your own work, you don't know what this place is really for. in fact, I'm glad it's like that.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: This facility is doing illegal experiments that are strictly forbidden by the government and Rekenber.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: You mean, our researchers...? No way.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Those people were doing experiments outside of the law?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What illegal experiments?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: That, I don't know in details yet.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Can't you tell us more about what they've been doing?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: You guys are supposed to be the good guys, then why do you call us the bad guys?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Exactly! That means these people have done bad things? Are the high members of Rekenber just going to come in and take the results of our scientists' research?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Right? Otherwise, the Vice President wouldn't have brought the Rebellions, but the guards instead.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are they really from the Enterprise? Why did the Vice President come here without the operatives?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are you acting alone?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: He does look like the Vice President though.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: This is a big problem. They don't believe us at all.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: I mean, how do you think the researchers have brainwashed these people over the years?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I'll talk to them, let me try.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Hello everyone. My name is Tes, I'm fron the office of the President of Schwarzwald.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
Some time ago, the Rekenber's laboratories have been under investigation because of their illegal experiments.
We've been cooperating with the Vice President over here.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text:
The Regenschirm lab, back at Rekenber, was involved with similar experiments and it caused a turmoil.
If you refuse to cooperate, you will be charged with illegal acts and  your refusal to cooperate.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are you threatening us now?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: No way! have we done anything wrong?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: This is our only job!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What gives you the right to just come here and charge us? We've been living her quietly for years. Did we sin?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Look around you. Even though you're having a hard time here, can you see any researcher trying to explain themselves?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Oh, they're just busy!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: They aren't as free as you are, they have work to do!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: There are no words to convince them.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Hmmm... I won't be able to conclude this easily, let's take a moment to discuss.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: No matter how much I tried to persuade them, they didn't listen. It's not easy to change someone's mind. I should discuss it with Tes.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: The Vice President, Kaya Tos, is going to persuade them. Let's listen to him.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: I can't get through to them just with words.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: You cannot use force against innocent people.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Even so, we might have to. We split in two teams, one of them keeps them from pursuing, and the rest enter and keep investigating.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: That sounds like a good idea.
Don't move!
Everything here is mine! I won't let you harm my friends! I'm not messing around!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Huh, senior researcher?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Elyumina?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Who gave you permission to approach my staff? You see them? Just try putting one hand on them, and I'll blow you up.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: No matter how stupid you are, it's always better to have your hands on your wrists, right?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Everyone get back! It's dangerous!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: You all look like skeletons, why aren't you hiding? You will all disappear!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Aaaaah!! Researcher! It's us! We're here too!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
You know what! If you have soybeans and rice, which one do you choose?
If you're in a hurry, you'll just mix them up!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why are you doing this?!!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Move behind me! Now!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Everyone, formation!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Argh...

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: What, what? Come on? Why is our attack.. not working...?

scripts.speaker: Fool 1
scripts.text: Dodge it!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Why? Why are they not budging? What about this?

scripts.speaker: Fool 2
scripts.text: Oh, I've been hit! We should escape!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Why are they doing so well? Did we pick the wrong test subjects?

scripts.speaker: Fool 1
scripts.text: These people are professionals!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: You are professionals too!

scripts.speaker: Fool 2
scripts.text: I'm also a high-end pro who gets money!! We don't have time to decide who's superior! Hurry up!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: No! Let me go! Now! I can't believe we can't avoid that kind of weapon! Let me go! Let me go!!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Is everyone alright?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'm okay, but the others...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Huh.. uh...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Ah.. argh!! I'm... gonna die!!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'll move the people to a safe location.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Let the rest of the people here look at where they went.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Some should stay here to watch out in case they come back, the rest of us will head to the <NAVI>[safe place]<INFO>sp_cor,122,141,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: This place is incredibly nice looking, it's hard to believe they do experiments here. Even I would want to live in a place like this.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: The problem is. We can't use force on them. What should we do?

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: Didn't you say the Vice President of Rekenber was going to convince them? What do you want to talk to me about?

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: I don't think this is going to work. What do you think Tes will say? The fight is still going on.

scripts.speaker: Advance Squad
scripts.text: It's dangerous here. Move over to the safe area!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: The Vice President is going to convince them.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Didn't Tes tell you to take action? If you aren't prepared, you should do that now.

scripts.speaker: Denny
scripts.text: I'm so curious what the inside looks like~

scripts.speaker: Denny
scripts.text: Wait, something's not right?

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: These people aren't armed? What are they playing at?

scripts.speaker: Magenta
scripts.text: I don't feel so well. We should get ready.

scripts.speaker: Tommy
scripts.text: It's nice here and quiet. If only I could get a day off...

scripts.speaker: Tommy
scripts.text: What is this big mansion in front of us? I've never seen anything like this before.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Who said it? Who's going to kick our butts?!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I came out to see what was that commotion, what is happening?!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are you seeing this? Show yourselves! Come on out!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I don't know why I keep standing here. If they asked something, I just decline. They're stamina monsters.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Today is supposed to be day off, but what is this! Are you responsible for it commotion?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I'll have a warm drink when this is over!!

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: This may be hard for you, but please investigate the entrance first.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Is everyone alright?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
No, really, just a little bit, I'm late am I? What is this all about, is it drugs?
Was I really this late? What is all of this, why is everyone wounded?

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Can't you tell from what you can see? Help with the work if you are free, there's no time to explain.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Hey, I was worried about all of this!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I can't... the chief researcher attacked us.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I was the one who made all this stuff and never once questioned it...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Why us...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Hey, don't say that.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Do you still trust the researchers? Is that what you're saying?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: No that's not it, I just can't believe it. Ugh, I'm so tired...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Please stay here, I will check the surroundings.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Take a look at the condition of the injured.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Alright, please stay here.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Do you know who she was?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Yes, she's one of the senior researchers, her name is ^0000CDElyumina.^000000

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: It was stupid thing to come and attack directly. What are they studying?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: That's because I'm the only mechanic in the lab. I don't care about anything other than my own machines...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Now that I think about it, her eyes were not normal. She looks like a crazy person.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Have you ever seen her room? I was frightened when I saw it the first time. She closed the door quickly, but I saw it.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Are you saying you've witnessed an illegal experiment?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Yeah, maybe it was. These machines moved strangely. Huh...

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Do you trust what we've been saying now?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Yes, I believe you! I absolutely believe you now!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: If it's not the vice president, who else would we trust!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Good. We can continue with our investigation now. Vice President, please give me the documents.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What documents?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The list of missing people. I need to double check with who we have here.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Here, stand in line please. Make three rows. Please tell me your full name when your turn comes.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Vice President, a moment... I have something to report

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What's the matter?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: It's not something I can tell you here, so please come over <NAVI>[here]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: Didn't you see <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> going with the Vice President? I'm worried about the wounded people.

scripts.speaker: Tes
scripts.text: It will take some time to finish the investigation and gather all the data here.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: This place is very dangerous. Come back when you're strong enough to protect your own body.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I hope we can find all the missing people here. I really do.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the injured. Let's go see what she wants to talk about.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Adventurer. Could I speak with you for a moment please?
What's the matter?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
You and others previously attacked a lab that's been conducting illegal experiments.
What do you think about this one?
I think this lab is the same.
I don't know

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I think this lab has also been doing illegal experiments. So... could I ask you a favor?

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I think this is the laboratory where the ^0000FFmissing people were sent to.^000000 Besides the people in this area, there might be other that we can't see right now.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I would like you to ^0000FFcontinue investigating Patrick Kaufmann's case.^000000
If he worked here, the others might people here know something about him.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Maybe... this is the last chance we'll have to find Patrick after all.
I'll look into it.
I have something else to do right now.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: It's okay, you don't have to look right now. There are other urgent matters to take care of.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: But please think of Kaufmann when you can.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Thank you. I'm sorry to have had to ask you this so suddenly.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Oh, welcome back adventurer. Come. Kaufmann, did you find him?
I have... this bracelet.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Those are...? What is that?
This is an identification bracelet.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: This is Kaufmann's...? Were there other people there?
- I told Kaya the story about the researcher you met at Rudus and about the experiments. -

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Why didn't the researcher come back with you?
She didn't want to come back...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I see...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Alright. Later, I will send a specialist to look for a body or remains. Again, Your services must be properly rewarded.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If you have the time, I hope you will give these experiments a proper rest. There is no one other than you... the adventurer, to see them through.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'm sorry to keep asking these hard task for you. If you can bring me their bracelets, I will reward you.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I will go back to the headquarters with the list of missing people. I'll use the bracelets as evidence and send the necessary compensation to their families.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: All future work will be handled through ^0000FFAas over here^000000. I will hand the bracelets to Aas.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Thank you for everything you have done so far.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the wounded people. Let's hear what she wants to talk about.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: We don't know when there will be an enemy attack. Come back when you can protect yourself.

scripts.speaker: Ashley
scripts.text: I honestly had no idea this place was hidden here. How the hell did they manage to avoid the surrounding people's attention?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: This way.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What's the status of the wounded people?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: They're being looked at seriously, but we're also getting some paperwork done about them.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: As we started treating them, we've found some ^0000FFserious health issues^000000 in addition to their injuries.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Tell me more.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: It seems they were ^0000FFpoisoned^000000 while moving waste materials and their clothes were contaminated by various dangerous substances used in the lab because they didn't have safety equipment.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: She didn't even follow basic safety rules. How many have been poisoned?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Yes, only the people resting over there...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Am I... dead?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Oh! The reporting site wasn't looking too good!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: But, when I die... what about my family... my family...

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Don't worry, you won't die.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Didn't you say we were about to die?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I said your bodies weren't healthy, but who said anything about dying?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Can I rest? Shouldn't I get back to work? If I don't work, my family will starve.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Hey, what about me!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I'm sick too! If I sleep, it will be cured in a day!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Oh. About that. You need professional treatment and care.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: No, it's not okay. I have to... I need to work.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
Then you'll really die. I don't think you want to die yet, right?
If you keep working, you will. You need to rest and be treated by professionals.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I can't keep working as the Vice President while the Enterprise is in this state.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Are you going to just get rid of us? If it's not you, it'll be someone else!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: I'll be taking care of this disaster instead. I will do everything to ensure your full recovery.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I'm glad to hear not all of you are bad people.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: If you are unhealthy, you should focus on getting better first.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: My Angela... I'll finally be able to see my Angela again....

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: But, well... what about us? We're in a relationship...

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Still, I want to keep working. We can write anywhere right? If we had a seat back at our headquarters...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
I do not know if there are jobs available back at headquarters.
I'll check up on that once.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Isn't there ^0000FFa lot of work^000000 to do here too? There's still waste materials... right? But I don't think the gunmen will stay here for more than a day or two.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: You know, we need people to chop trees, cook, clean, and who will wash our clothes? I don't think it's possible.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: What? Are we even strong enough to eat food?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: No way... we know where to catch the fishes... where the good mushrooms are... where the best spots for the bathroom are... you guy don't know any of that.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: She's right! Nobody else knows this place as much as we do.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I understand what they're saying.

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text:
Hmm... well, I guess we need to keep people here who knows this place. Alright, I've decided.
Anyone who's in good enough shape and wishes to remain can stay here and they will still be hired.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Oh my... thank you....

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Thank you! Thank you!
These people are victims too...

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: As Lazy was saying, I think Rekenber has used these people because of their desperation.

scripts.speaker: Search Team
scripts.text: We need support from the adventurer!

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: What is it? Are the wounded people okay?

scripts.speaker: Search Team
scripts.text: We were tracking the attacker, some of us got injured and now we ^0000FFneed backup.^000000

scripts.speaker: Kaya
scripts.text: Attacker?

scripts.speaker: Search Team
scripts.text: There were some traps set up, and some of us were injured because of it.

scripts.speaker: Search Team
scripts.text:
The Advanced Team has difficulty searching everything on its own,
the adventurer's help would be appreciated! Please join the Search Team on the <NAVI>[left]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I honestly had no idea this place was hidden here. How the hell did they manage to avoid the surrounding people's attention?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Hello. Do you need anything?
I'm going back to Rudus.
Is there anything I can help with?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: There is nothing else to ask of you adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: If you have time, how about you go back to Rudus and find more Identification Bracelets?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Hello you're back already adventurer? What's the matter? Do you need anything?
I'm going to Rudus.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Already? You've been there for a while today, right? I know it's not easy,You should take a break.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I need some time to sort out the bracelets that you've brought earlier.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: I'll see you again at dawn.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Hello, are you going to Rudus?
Yes. I'll be going.
I can't go today.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: It's alright, you need to take breaks as well, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: It won't be easy, but please put to rest 20 ^0000FFDolors specimens^000000 and collect 10 ^0000FFIdentification Bracelets^000000 from them.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Please be careful. I know you will do well.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Have you finished the work in Rudus?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Oh..., I thought the Vice President told you to put them to rest?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Have you finished the work in Rudus?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Oh... huh, I thought the Vice President told you to put them to rest?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: Have you finished the work in Rudus?

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text: You brought ^0000FF10 identification bracelet^000000... Alright, I received them.

scripts.speaker: Aas
scripts.text:
I will see you again at dawn.
You must be pretty tired.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: The <NAVI>[guard]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> seems to have something to say to the VIP. Is it a problem with the wounded people?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Do you think this is where they are? I have to find the missing people.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I really can't believe they did illegal experiments on this place. Why does it look so nice?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
{0}.
We're still searching, so don't go too deep. We don't know what might be lurking in there.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
You came, Adventurer. You know why I wanted to see you, right?
It's because of that angry researcher who ran away. As you can see, we haven't found him. He's as slippery as an eel.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly. Don't you agree?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Ack, what was that?

scripts.speaker: Rebellion
scripts.text:
Captain, there was another explosion near the facilities!
That researcher named ^0000CDElyumina^000000 must have done it. We'll go after him right away!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
So, he knows he can't take us head-on. He's using guerrilla tactics.
Let's go. {0}, follow me <NAVI>[this way]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
There was an explosion near the facilities. It was caused by that researcher at this lab, Elyumina.
We must capture him without fail this time. Come <NAVI>[this way]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly. Don't you agree?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Mm? Adventurer, don't act on your own. I know I can trust you, but the others don't.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Some of the researchers or their devices can remain. Stay with the others in the areas we've cleared.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: What about me? Why am I here alone? Are you worried about me? Ho ho ho!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
You're a bit late. Well, we didn't come exactly in time, either.
We lost Elyumina. He may not be a good fighter, but he's really good at running. Drat!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: We won't be able to search or restore this area unless we catch him first.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: I talked to the other captains of the Rebellion, and have decided to evacuate everyone in this area and release our elite troops for his search.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: The evacuation process has already begun, moving the civilians and the President's little soldiers out of the area.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: The elite members of USU and the other Rebellion forces have been selected, and I'll be their commander. The rest of the Rebellion will keep all the entries to Cor blocked.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Our operation also includes you, Adventurer. I know how good you are, so I've recommended you to the others. You'll do this with us, won't you?
Of course.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Alright!
For this operation, we've only picked the soldiers who are strong enough to fend for themselves, such as me. Please come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Hey, Adventurer. Why didn't you tell me you did what I asked? I almost asked you again.
But no need to report to me now. My men already did on your behalf.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
The area has been closed. The evacuation process is almost complete.
We'll go in there soon. Soldiers, are you ready?

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Alright, you're the elite of the elites in the Rebellion, especially picked to capture this researcher who's been attacking everyone in this area, friend and foe alike.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
As for you, Adventurer, please select Ready and wait for us.
When MD is activated, select Enter. Our operation will begin as soon as you do.
^ff0000Please note that you can't clear this dungeon if you try to tame monsters or perform any other irrelevant monster-related activities.^000000

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
I told you, you have to do this alone.
Use the ^0000Cd/organize [party name]^000000 command and come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Wait, are you trying to take other adventurers with you?
I trust you, but I don't know about your friends. Please come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.
Ready
Enter
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: There seems to be a problem. Your request has failed. Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact the Operation Team.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Alright, if MD is activated, talk to me again and select ^0000CDEnter^000000. Our operation will begin as soon as you enter.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Your party leader hasn't created the dungeon. Check with them.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: The dungeon is not created yet. Check again.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: What kind of error is this? Check it.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: What is it? What, are you nervous? You look nervous.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: There seems to be a problem. If I unnecessarily repeat myself, you should contact the Operation Team.

scripts.speaker: Alert
scripts.text: - Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Good job, everyone! Ho ho! You guys, I knew I could trust you!
Ah, Adventurer, you too. Good job!

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Thanks to you, we've successfully captured Elyumina. Now that we don't have to worry about his random attacks, the President's little soldiers and the civilians can go back home.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Rookie and the President's soldiers called the Wings something are getting ready to interrogate him.
They're clearing the place that you fought the last machine to use it as an interrogation room.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Since I'm the type who prefers force over talking to get the answer she wants, I probably won't have anything to do there,
but maybe Goni and I can stand in the back, glaring daggers at him.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Why don't you come join us <NAVI>[there]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?
You can stand next to us and glare, or you can help Rookie interrogate.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: There seems to be a problem. If I unnecessarily repeat myself, you should contact the Operation Team.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Rookie and the President's soldiers called the Wings something are getting ready to interrogate him.
They're clearing the place that you fought the last machine to use it as an interrogation room.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Since I'm the type who prefers force over talking to get the answer she wants, I probably won't have anything to do there,
but maybe Goni and I can stand in the back, glaring daggers at him.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Why don't you come join us <NAVI>[there]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?
You can stand next to us and glare, or you can help Rookie interrogate.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Hey, are you busy?
I'll be traveling often between here and the Rebellion base for a while.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: Places like this are prone to accidents that the regular members of the Rebellion can't handle.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
When you finally have some time, come to Clana Nemieri for another match with me.
I don't hate destroying machines, but it's not as fun as fighting you.

scripts.speaker: Goni
scripts.text: *Nod*

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Ah, you came early. I thought you'd come later after a break.
Mr. Lazy, please bring out the prisoner.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Yes, sir. Here he is.
It hasn't been that long since we met, and you're already bossing me around.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: I knew you had it in you, Lucky Rookie. I've got a good eye for people. I'm so amazing!

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Gah, you fools! Stop manhandling me! My body's precious! I'm more valuable than all of you muscleheads combined!

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text: Oops, sorry. Now, Rookie, good luck to you.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
This shouldn't have happened.
Please contact the Operation Team.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Err, then...
(Am I really interrogating him?)

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
... Hey, take it easy. You're in no position to demand anything.
You've done some serious damage to us.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Stuff it! What about the damage you've done on me?
You invaded my lab and tried to steal my research results!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
If you mean your illegal experimentation results,
didn't you know they might get you in trouble one day?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Well, that doesn't matter. You care about your research, don't you?
Cooperate with us, and we'll help you continue with it.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Only the part that's legal, of course. But we'll make sure you can keep it. So, tell us everything you know about this place and your coworkers.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
My coworkers? I don't care about those lunatics.
They're not my coworkers. I only used them for my research.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Come to think of it, your name wasn't on the employee list from the company.
Who are you? What kind of research did you need them for?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Don't you know who I am? I'm Schwarzwald's--no, the continent's greatest machine learning researcher. I bet you all have seen my serviceroids.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: ... Nope.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Hmpf, you probably didn't even know they were serviceroids.
I was so close to transplanting human minds into my machines.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: I could have given you my beautiful machine bodies, so you could forever preserve the knowledge that you all have worked so hard to accumulate.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Do you get it? I was doing something greater than any one of you fools can imagine.
My research is nothing compared to the childish works of Vor, Wer, whatever their names were.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Vor-who? Vorseff? Or Werner? Do you know them?

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text: Well, I know both names, but they don't interest me. Both of them risked their lives for stupid things.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Maybe it's time you should take more interest. We want you to talk.
Listen up. You've got two choices.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
First, you could decide to be stubborn
and not to tell us about your illegal research or your friends.
You stay loyal to them in exchange for... The death sentence. In this case, you'll have no future.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Or you could be more considerate of your future
and provide us information about your coworkers who were only your business partners. In this case, you'll get to keep your research, though in a limited capacity.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: You'll have to pay for what you did, of course, but eventually, you'll be able to do what you want.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
We're offering you a plea bargain. We're making sacrifices by offering it to you because we really believe you're onto something great.
I hope you'll make the right decision.

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
... I really don't know what the others did in their rooms.
...Can I still keep the bargain?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Mm... Sure, why not? If you cooperate with us as best as you can, then we can let the minor details slide.
Now, let's get down to the business, shall we? Please send him here, Mr. Lazy.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
...
Hey, Hot-blooded Captain over there.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: ... Are you talking to me?

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Then, who else? You're the only captain here.
I was just going to ask you to stop glaring, since he's cooperating now.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Ah... Mm, yes.
Rookie did a great job. I didn't know he was so good at persuasion.

scripts.speaker: Lazy
scripts.text:
Of course not. You never gave him a chance.
But now that you know, let him handle the rest.

scripts.speaker: Elena
scripts.text: Hm...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
What were you guys talking about? He told me everything we need to know.
His group was called ^0000CDIllusion^000000, consisting of ^0000Cdformer members of Regenschirm^000000.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Elyumina doesn't seem to know a lot about his group, though.
He had almost zero contact with the company. He received his funds from Illusion in exchange for his research results. That was why he wasn't on the list.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
And beyond this lab site is ^0000CDBarmund's mansion^000000, which used to be hidden.
Illusion was created after the mansion's discovery, to monopolize on the knowledge available inside the place.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Elyumina doesn't know how the mansion looks like on the inside
because she chose to stay behind the others who entered the mansion, to protect his research data.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Through the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the far right side of the fence.
We need more information and also have to round up the researchers. Why don't we all go together? Captain? Adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Through the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the far right side of the fence.
We need more information and also have to round up the researchers. Why don't we all go together? Captain? Adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Adventurer, you'll be the first one to know I have news.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Erm, we're still investigating this side, Adventurer.
We don't know what kind of danger lurks here. Please don't come any closer.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: The water in this waterway looks clean, but we want to send it for an analysis.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: This place is filled with so many unpleasant surprises that I'm constantly reminding myself to be wary of everything I see.

scripts.speaker: Alert
scripts.text: - Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Ah, man. I think this is, but I can't open it. Is it too rusty or what?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Ah, you want to try? Thank you, Goni.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Goni, are you serious? Ooh, I see. Interesting...

scripts.speaker: Elyumina
scripts.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? I told you nothing but the truth. That really is the entrance.
Why would I lie in a situation like that? I'm not that stupid, you know.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Who says you are? We've found the entrance.
But it's locked from the inside. Even Goni couldn't open it, and he's the strongest of us all. That's what I find interesting.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I should have checked if you talked to the others before you talked to us. Now, it's too late.
You're more loyal than I thought. Not stupid, either.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Adventurer, the Rebellion will keep this place surrounded and investigate the perimeter.
Now that we know what that place is, we can't leave it alone.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: We have a long love-and-hate relationship with both the government and the company. Even if Illusion isn't related to either of them, we must retrieve Barmund's legacy from it.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
But for now, we can't get in because the gate is shut.
I'll let you know if we come across more information. Until then, please get some rest.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text:
Ah, right. Elyumina will also be kept here for a while.
He knows Illusion better than we do. We can't afford to lose him.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: While he's with us, we'll also see if he can modify the damaged weapons found here for us.

scripts.speaker: Elena Volkova
scripts.text: If you're interested in that, you can ask my smart <NAVI>[subordinates]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for more details.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
There are still many things to do around here. If you're not busy, maybe you can stay and help us.
Now, good luck, Adventurer! We'll contact you if we come across new information!

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I'll get back to you when I get more info. So take a break for a while.
Elyumina should also be in charge here for the time being.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: We'll keep an eye on it and suggest modifying the damaged weapons we can get here for our own use.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: If you're an adventurer, if you're interested, it's managed by Captain Volkova's <NAVI>[subordinates]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, so go and ask.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
There's still quite a bit of work to do around here, so if you're free, feel free to help out.
Then good luck, adventurer! I'll be in touch when I learn something new!
^4d4dffThese quests are available from level 130 or higher.^000000

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
You're welcome.
I opened the entrance here last night.
Elyumina said that somehow the device that was sealing it from the inside is broken.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
It must have been one of the devices of the Illusion and Heart Hunters to keep the entrance shut.
I'm glad that we're able to open it and move inside.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Some of the rebellions have already entered the mansion.
Maybe the Illusions intended to open it... because the inside is full of experiments...

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
but I'm sure the rebellions who entered the mansion, is fine.
You can enter whenever you're ready, adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Even though I opened it, I don't plan to leave the door open at all times.
I was only waiting for you to come.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
... Hmm, for some reason, I feel like I'm always playing the role of a gatekeeper?
Is it only for adventurers? You must be feeling bad, huh? Ha-ha-ha-ha

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: I'll open the door anytime you need to need, adventurer. Just let me know.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Shall we go?
To the great mansion left by the great sages?
Let's Go!
Not now.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Let me know whenever you are ready.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
I heard that the advance team already cleaned up the inside, but occasionally something is coming out this way... it's hard for me to see something sticking out this way from time to time.
First, I'll tell you where to go.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The gate you're about to enter... we're calling it the entrance, but it's actually the exit.
It's a giant sewer. If you walk along the sewer, you'll find a huge sewage treatment plant inside.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
If you go past the sewage treatment plant, there is a one huge magic power plant inside.
It seems that power plant supports the entire mansion.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Through the power plant, you can get to the garden of mansion.
The mansion's manager is staying near the garden. be sure to meet them first.
Manager?

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
If you look around closely, you'll understand.
They seem to be having a hard time because of the intruders.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Many other volunteer adventurer have entered before us.
The sewage plant is quite complicated and you could get lost.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
There might be a colleague that ^4D4DFFfell behind^000000, Please move together with them.
Before you register as a guest in the mansion, prioritize everyone's safety first.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text: Then, this way.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
Go ahead and enter the mansion through this sewer.
Most of the colleagues who went in first cleaned up already.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
There might be a colleague that ^4D4DFFfell behind^000000, Please move together with them.
Before you register as a guest in the mansion, prioritize everyone's safety first.

scripts.speaker: Rookie
scripts.text:
The path we took with you adventurer is a fresh feeling for me.
I feel really alive these days.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I'll have to split the workforce because I only have so few people remaining.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: We'll have to take turns.
Do you know Patrick Kaufmann?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Who?
Patrick Kaufmann. Facility Maintenance Officer.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Patrick Kaufmann? Don't you mean Patrick Young?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: He's the logistic guy.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Where's the facility department here?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: I knew before I came here!

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Patrick is in the Facility Maintenance Department? That I didn't know. Nobody here worked as their usual job. When I got here, I was assigned a different job.
Who decides what you guys do?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Who decides? It's the researchers.
When we arrived here, we were set up in a line and then one after the other, we were interviewed. Then we were assigned a job.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: When I think about it, his eyes were so beautiful.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Anyway, if you're looking for someone in particular, you should ^0000FFask the researchers.^000000 Most of them already ran away, but a few stayed behind.
The <NAVI>[researcher]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right next to the crops. Do you see her?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text:
Anyway, if you're looking for someone in particular, you should ^0000FFask the researchers.^000000 Most of them already ran away, but a few stayed behind.
The <NAVI>[researcher]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right next to the crops. Do you see her?

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Now I can't think of anything else, I'm in a bad mood. I'll get back to work soon...

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text:
Anyway, what about all of these...?
It's too bad that they won't be used.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: You... you're the adventurer that came with the gunmen. Am I in trouble? I didn't know anything about these illegal experiments or the institute.
I'm looking for a person.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: Who? Patrick? I don't know him. I don't know many people, I'm only focused on the field work here.
Why are the researchers doing the field work?

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: Well... in short, it was to feed the study animals, I was growing super vegetables that would sustain the animals for life.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text:
Processing and refining the vegetables... with these... what were they trying to do?? Did they try solve the hunger problems?
Actually, I don't know. Maybe you do.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: The chief researchers here know all the details. I honestly didn't know they would just leave like that. I thought they were like a family to me...

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: The chief told me to pack my bags because there was a disturbance outside. I was hesitating because I had to take care of my crops, but then everyone had already left.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: I understood the moment I heard the Vice President talking. I worked with pride, but I was only making consumables for my senior researcher in the end.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: After all, I was blinded by my own ego. I didn't realize anything of what was happening.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: Anyway, I'm looking for a <NAVI>[person]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> to do my laundry. It's been a while and my feet are dirty.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text: Anyway, I'm looking for a <NAVI>[person]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do my laundry. It's been a while and my feet are dirty.

scripts.speaker: Researcher
scripts.text:
Anyway, how about all of these...?
I'm afraid they will go to waste if I just leave.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Huh... I don't want to wash these things, uh... it seems like the inside is burnt.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Hey, don't come any closer. These are contaminated items. Look out.
I have something to ask you.

scripts.speaker: Worker
scripts.text: Oh, you saved us! My name is Marcus. What are you doing here?
Marcus Holzman from Lighthalzen?

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: Do you know me? I don't know you....
Are you familiar with Eva?

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: No, who are you, really? How do you know Eva Mueller? Did Eva send you? How is she doing? Oh my god! Eva! How is Eva doing?

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: Eva, I want to see Eva again. Did she forget about me? I haven't been able to contact her for several years.
She worries because she hasn't been contacted.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: I couldn't send letters. I couldn't contact the outside either, and I can't get out of here. These are the rules of this place.
Well, it says you're on vacation.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: Vacation? I've been working everyday since I've came here. What makes you say that?
I'm investigating missing people.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: I can't thank you enough.
I can forward your letters for you.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: Really... you'd do that for me.... if we had meet sooner, we'd have been long life friends. If you need help with anything, let me know.
Do you know Patrick Kaufmann?

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text:
It's a familiar name... Patrick... Patrick... Are you talking about Pat who was cleaning the labs?
Wasn't he the guy who came from Lighthalzen too?
Yes, that's him.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: That's right, that's right! The guy who looked tall and big. I wanted to be his friend because we came from the same place. I couldn't see him one day. Then I was moved.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: It was a Facility Maintenance Department, I told them things weren't supposed to work that way.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: I'm ^0000FFfamiliar with the people^000000 who work in the lab, I've seen him a few times as I passed by. Did he stop working there?

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text:
Anyway, if you want to know more, check out the <NAVI>[incinerator]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
They're working on collecting and sorting the scattered materials, so maybe they know something else about Pat.

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: These laundries will be moved to the incinerator soon. Huh, not good. If you pass them once in the washing machine, they won't always be clean...

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text: Thank you. I have written many letters during my stay, so I'll sort them out. Thank you again!

scripts.speaker: Marcus
scripts.text:
Anyway, if you want to know more, check out the <NAVI>[incinerator]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
They're working on collecting and sorting the scattered materials, so maybe they know something else about Pat.
